title: Job Board and Candidate Application Platform

prd.oneLiner: Connect job-seeker profiles, companies and listings, search and saves, applications, status updates, reporting and review, and marketplace outcomes in one job-board flow.
prd.goal: Help job seekers find relevant roles quickly and help employers manage a transparent application journey.
prd.whyNow: Job seekers compare listings across channels and track applications separately, while employers struggle to manage listing quality and applicant questions consistently.
prd.problem: Job seekers compare listings across channels and track applications separately, while employers struggle to manage listing quality and applicant questions consistently.
prd.solution: Connect job-seeker profiles, companies and listings, search and saves, applications, status updates, reporting and review, and marketplace outcomes in one job-board flow.
prd.alternatives: Email, chat, spreadsheets, and manual ledgers
prd.differentiator: Manage intake, processing, and operations data as one connected source of truth.

targets.name: Job seeker
targets.needs: Compare relevant listings and check application status.
targets.pain: Job seekers compare listings across channels and track applications separately, while employers struggle to manage listing quality and applicant questions consistently.

targets.name: Employer
targets.needs: Publish listings and manage applicant responses.
targets.pain: Job seekers compare listings across channels and track applications separately, while employers struggle to manage listing quality and applicant questions consistently.

scenarios.text: A participant discovers and saves a relevant listing.
A publisher creates a listing and checks response status.
A participant checks report outcomes and visibility settings.
A participant adjusts alert preferences and returns.

prd.northStar: Share of operations requests completed on time

kpis.name: Discovery-to-action conversion
kpis.target: Help job seekers find relevant roles quickly and help employers manage a transparent application journey.
kpis.method: Share of discovery sessions that lead to a save, application, or response

kpis.name: Response-status visibility
kpis.method: Share of participants who view a status update

kpis.name: Report-outcome visibility
kpis.method: Share of reports followed by an outcome or next-step notice

inScope: Job-seeker profile, resume, job listing, and company-profile entry
Listing, application, saved job, application status, company, and report-history lookup
Listing publication, search, application submission, status update, listing review, and report handling
Listing views, application conversion, employer response, listing quality, and report-resolution reporting
Job-seeker profile, resume, job listing, and company-profile entry review and saving
Saved items, response history, and search preferences
Reporting, safety guidance, and outcome status
nonGoals: Replacing adjacent systems such as accounting or payroll
assumptions: User and organization data are available through company SSO.
Operators manage policy and classification criteria.
risks: Weak initial classification can cause incorrect processing.
Stale source data can reduce operational trust.
openQuestions: What defines urgent processing and approval?
What are the post-completion verification and reopen rules?
constraints: State, owner, and priority changes require audit logs.
Participants must be able to control their profile and visibility.
Reporting and safety actions must communicate an outcome or next step to the participant.
